changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries, removed non-model components (style classifier and discriminator are evaluation/constraint mechanisms, not generation models), simplified model names by removing redundant descriptions, and removed overly specific example outputs while keeping general descriptions.
Consolidated duplicate metric entries under canonical names (Accuracy instead of ACC/Accuracy (ACC), Perplexity instead of PPL/Perplexity (PPL)), kept G2 and H2 as distinct composite metrics
Paper does not use LLMs as judges (pre-LLM era for EMNLP 2021), removed placeholder 'None' entries

guideline: Annotators score each transfer result from 1 (lowest quality) to 5 (highest quality) on style compatibility, content preservation, and fluency

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to title case, consolidated guideline description

overall_notes: This paper presents a text style transfer method (CBD) evaluated on sentiment (YELP) and formality (GYAFC) transfer tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancies and overly specific outputs. The paper uses standard automatic metrics (Accuracy, BLEU, Perplexity) and human evaluation with clear criteria. No LLM evaluation is used (paper predates widespread LLM-as-judge usage). The models listed are appropriate as they represent the main method (CBD) and all baselines compared against.
